verdict.rationale: Fivetran ships a Python Connector SDK for building and deploying custom connectors. It also provides first-party AI coding agent plugins that add Connector SDK skills to Claude Code, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI and GitHub Copilot CLI, so connectors can be built, tested and deployed from natural-language prompts, plus a Cursor tutorial. The AI drafting depends on an external coding agent rather than a native in-product generator, and nothing shows it working from API documentation. Missing for 10: drafting from API documentation, specific handling of auth, pagination and streams, a review-before-ship workflow, and independent hands-on corroboration.
